Welcome to the HealthEquine Therapies YouTube Channel!

The plan is to bring an assortment of educational videos to our clients and the horse world with a click of a button.
Expect to find videos on an assortment of topics that have relevance to equine health and well-being!

Caring for Your Horse...Naturally!

Facebook: www.facebook.com/HealthEquineTherapies/
Instagram: @HealthEquine Therapies
